pr.title: Rename the fix loop to the watch loop
pr.head: 9ab6a7a5aeee7939f047e0ac5d031e9fbffb51ed

summary: Projector runs two background loops beside a conversation. The review loop reviews each new head of a pull request. The other loop, which implement starts on every pull request it opens, watches that pull request's review threads, verdicts, review bodies, and merge conflicts, and hands each pull request that has work to fix-pr. Until this change that second loop was called the fix loop, and its skill was start-fix-loop.

The loop itself fixes nothing: fix-pr does the fixing, and the loop watches. This pull request renames the loop to the watch loop everywhere Projector still describes it. The skill directory moves to skills/start-watch-loop/, the config key fix.auto_start becomes watch.auto_start, and the generated AGENTS.md block moves to template version 6.

• Kept on purpose. fix-pr, the fix-<number> and fix-stack-<number> subagents the loop starts, and the fix.resolve_human_threads key keep their names, because they fix. Completed plans keep their wording as a record.
  • No fallback. Projector stops reading fix.auto_start. A repository that set it to false starts getting a watch loop until it sets watch.auto_start.
  • Adopting repositories. The template change makes project check report the block as stale in every repository that adopted Projector, until project init refreshes it.

cards.title: Review so far
cards.html: One Projector review at 9ab6a7a requested changes, with one open finding. One sentence in skills/implement/SKILL.md still says "fix loop". The phrase breaks across lines 180 and 181, so the pull request's line-based git grep check cannot match it.

cards.title: Terms on this page
cards.html:
• Watch loop. The loop start-watch-loop runs. It polls the tracked pull requests with watch-threads.sh and starts a fix-pr subagent for each one with work.
  • Review loop. The loop start-review-loop runs. It reviews each new head with review-pr. This change leaves its name alone.
  • AGENTS.md block. The section between projector:begin markers that project init writes into a repository's AGENTS.md, rendered from src/projector/templates/agents-block.md.

groups.title: The skill and its watcher move
groups.kicker: skills/start-fix-loop becomes skills/start-watch-loop, with its tests
intro: The skill's directory is its published name, so moving skills/start-fix-loop/ to skills/start-watch-loop/ renames the skill a user invokes, as /projector:start-watch-loop in Claude Code or $start-watch-loop in Codex. The watcher script watch-threads.sh moves with it. Its content changes only in comments.
Tests that name the old path follow it. tests/test_packaging.py checks the exact set of published skills, so it fails if a manifest or a directory still uses the old name.

checks.text: The Claude Code band finds a running watcher by the script's file name, not its directory: hooks/parse.ts maps watch-threads.sh to a watching kind. I read it and ran claude plugin test ., which ended 51 pass, 0 fail.

files.note: The moved skill. Its frontmatter name, title, and one sentence change. The description still says it runs fix-pr, which stays true.

groups.title: The implement hand-over and its setting
groups.kicker: implement starts a watch loop, gated by watch.auto_start
intro: When implement opens a pull request, the top-level conversation starts the loop on it, or adds the pull request to the loop it already runs. The setting that turns that off was fix.auto_start and is now watch.auto_start. Projector reads the key only through project config get in the skill, so no Python code changes.
Projector reads no fallback, by the pull request's own choice: the author states that nobody relies on the old name yet.

files.note: Every mention of the loop in the hand-over section, and the config key, change.

checks.text: The sentence on lines 180 and 181 still reads "When this conversation already runs a fix loop". That sentence is the one that keeps implement from starting a second watcher, and nothing else in Projector uses the old name now. The open review finding asks to change it to "watch loop".

files.note: The configuration table renames the key, and the project init description names the watch loop.

checks.text: This table row is the only reference documentation for the key. A repository that set fix.auto_start = false must set watch.auto_start = false instead.

files.note: The plugin guide's skill list, stacking paragraph, and band description use the new name and key.

groups.title: The generated AGENTS.md block
groups.kicker: The template names the loop, so its version moves to 6
intro: project init writes a block of conventions into each adopting repository's AGENTS.md, and the block names the loop. A template change must bump the version in the block's opening marker, and tests/test_instructions.py pins a hash for every version so that an edit without a bump fails. This repository's own AGENTS.md carries the refreshed block.

checks.text: The full unit suite passed at this head (881 tests, OK), including the pinned hash for version 6, and project check printed Project plans are valid.

files.note: The template: version 6 and "watch loop" in the hand-over paragraph.
